question: can Newton implicit-MPM contain granular material inside the grab v1 shell?
method: closed grab (or a 6 mm-walled box control) held static 30 mm above the floor, filled with MPM material placed >=3 mm from every shell vertex, 2 s of settling, count what falls below the vessel floor
reason: a 1.03 mm shell wall is transparent to a grid-based solver whose finest practical voxel is 2.5 mm; the 6 mm-walled control holds 100% at the same voxels, and the identical first-step speeds rule out an ejection artifact
non_claims: this bounds Newton MPM's collider fidelity for THIS tool, not MPM in general
DEM collides particles against triangles directly and has no such resolution limit
retraction_2026_09_01: 초판 verdict 는 MPM_CANNOT_REPRESENT_THIS_TOOL 이었다. 철회한다. 이 표의 셸은 ShapeConfig.margin 기본값 0.0 때문에 collider thickness 0 으로 들어갔고, sdf = d - thickness 이므로 두께 0 인 면이었다. 마진을 켜면 잔류가 0.2% -> 19.1% 로 단조 증가한다(별도 pour 실험). 완전 포획 설정은 미발견이며 '불가능'은 증명되지 않았다.
nvidia_example_collider_to_voxel: example_mpm_granular voxel 0.1m + box 0.5x2.0x0.8m; twoway_coupling voxel 0.05m + box; anymal = robot shank links. 전부 부피 충돌체이고 복셀의 5~20배. 얇은 셸 예제는 패키지에 없음.
